metaDescription: Order custom 4 oz shot glasses for your next event or promotion. Perfect for tastings and giveaways. Get a quote today!
introHtml: Custom 4 oz shot glasses offer a generous serving size ideal for liquor tastings, dessert shooters, or promotional events where a standard 1.5 oz shot feels too small. These larger glasses provide more surface area for your logo or message, making them stand out at bars, breweries, or corporate parties. Choose from glass or plastic options, and decorate with screen printing, etching, or full-color digital printing for a polished look that keeps your brand top of mind.
heroAltText: Custom 4 oz shot glasses with engraved logo, perfect for promotional events and tastings.
